**Date:** 25-26 January 2027

**Location:**  Department of Statistical Sciences, University of Padua (via C. Battisti, 241, 35121 Padua, room SC60) 

*Theory, Methods and Applications in Extreme Value Analysis*: a two-day winter school on Extreme Value Analysis. 

School instructors: [Simone A. Padoan](https://www.unibocconi.it/en/faculty/simone-padoan), [Stefano Rizzelli](https://homes.stat.unipd.it/stefanorizzelli/en/home-2), [Carlo Gaetan](https://www.unive.it/data/people/5591383)

More information coming soon. 

**Application**: those interested in taking part in the school are required to fill in the [application form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe3RRZ7Ev1vGsuQNd8t3TFSjwAzpQAdXTmRMnvu97WzND3TuQ/viewform?usp=dialog) by 30 October 2026. 

**Contact:** Send an email to <stefano.rizzelli@unipd.it> if you want to join.
